base_prompt: Every blue folder is labeled, but some labeled folders are green. Explain which conclusions about an unlabeled folder are justified and which are not. Please answer in roughly 120 words.
text: Because every blue folder is labeled, an unlabeled folder cannot be blue: if it were blue, it would have to be labeled. This is a justified conclusion by contraposition. However, nothing definite follows about whether the unlabeled folder is green. The statement that some labeled folders are green only confirms that at least one folder has both properties; it does not say that all green folders are labeled, all labeled folders are green, or that unlabeled folders cannot be green. Therefore, the folder might be green or might not be green. It is also not justified to conclude that it is any particular other color, or that all unlabeled folders share the same properties.
